comment: Roof-form evaluation (roofaccuracy.py), data not code. The evaluation set is drawn and hand-labelled from NAIP imagery BEFORE the classifier is changed; the tuning set (different seed, disjoint from the evaluation set) is the only set the new complex rule may be fitted on. Draw: the n refs with the smallest sha256(seed|area id|ref) among the OSM-keyed classified roofs (way/ and relation/ refs) of the committed lidar-roofs.json before the change.

labelProtocol.flat: no visible ridge or slope: flat or nearly flat roof (parapet, membrane, gravel, mechanical units); a single mono-pitch slope also counts as gable only if a ridge is visible, otherwise flat
labelProtocol.gable: one main roof mass with a single ridge and two opposite slopes
labelProtocol.hip: one main roof mass with a ridge (or point) and slopes on all four sides
labelProtocol.complex: two or more distinct roof masses or ridge directions of comparable size: L, T or U plans, cross gables, a wing or addition whose roof is at least about a fifth of the whole, or a large flat part beside a large pitched part
labelProtocol.mansard: steep lower slopes round a flat or shallow top on at least three sides
labelProtocol.ignore: dormers, chimneys, small porch or bay roofs, skylights, solar panels, mechanical boxes and tree shadow do not make a roof complex
labelProtocol.cant_tell: tree cover, shadow or image quality hides the roof, or the footprint is not a roof (the label is excluded from every accuracy figure and counted)
